swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: AP62200WU-7 uses TSOT-23-6 (6-pin, TSOT26) while TPS54331DR uses SOIC-8 (8-pin, D); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 2 (SW vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs SS), Pin 5 (EN vs FB), Pin 6 (BOOT vs COMP), Pin 7 (NONE vs GND), Pin 8 (NONE vs SW). Soldering TPS54331DR onto a AP62200WU-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL RECTIFICATION LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: TPS54331DR is non-synchronous and requires an external Schottky catch/freewheeling diode footprint near SW, whereas the counterpart integrates a synchronous low-side MOSFET.
CRITICAL SWITCH-VOLTAGE OVERSTRESS RISK: AP62200WU-7 is rated up to only 7 V output (p.1) vs TPS54331DR up to 25 V (p.21); exceeding the internal switch BVdss ceiling destroys the SW MOSFET.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP62200WU-7: 3.3 µH p.17 vs TPS54331DR: 6.8 µH p.16); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (AP62200WU-7: 18 V p.4 vs TPS54331DR: 28 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP62200WU-7 specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS54331DR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP62200WU-7 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (20 V, p.4) than TPS54331DR (30 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 20 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 66% higher on TPS54331DR (AP62200WU-7: 70 °C/W p.4 vs TPS54331DR: 116.3 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AP62200WU-7 requires Vin,min >= 4.2 V (p.4) vs 3.5 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP62200WU-7: -40..125 °C Industrial / Extended (-40°C to 125°C TJ) vs TPS54331DR: -40..150 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 150°C TJ)); AP62200WU-7 hot limit only 125 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP62200WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and TPS54331DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 2 (SW vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs SS), Pin 5 (EN vs FB), Pin 6 (BOOT vs COMP), Pin 7 (NONE vs GND), Pin 8 (NONE vs SW); synchronous vs non-synchronous rectification mismatch (external Schottky footprint). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 2 (SW vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs SS). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (non-sync), switching frequency 750 kHz (p.5) vs 570 kHz (p.6) (1.3x ratio), typical inductor 3.3 µH (p.17) vs 6.8 µH (p.16), feedback Vref 0.8 V (p.5) vs 0.8 V (p.5), and package θJA 70 vs 116.3 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP62200WU-7 "CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 8.0 V — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 18 V VIN!" (p.4) and TPS54331DR "Non-Synchronous Architecture Requires External Schottky Catch Diode & External COMP Network" (p.1). BOM decision: Choose AP62200WU-7 when you want synchronous rectification without an external Schottky diode; choose TPS54331DR when bus voltage exceeds 18 V (rated to 28 V) or higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
